instruction: Use command line tools to reduce the image width to 640 pixels while maintaining the aspect ratio and save it as "reduced.png" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires reducing width to 640 pixels while maintaining aspect ratio. Original is 962x1280 (aspect ratio 0.751563). Expected output is 640x851. Evaluator checks width is 640 and aspect ratio is preserved within 1% tolerance. Verified with Python calculation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: width reduction to 640 pixels, aspect ratio preservation, and output file location
Getter logic correctly extracts image dimensions from /home/user/Desktop/reduced.png using PIL and calculates aspect ratio as width/height
Metric logic correctly verifies width matches expected value (640) and aspect ratio is preserved within 1% tolerance
Expected values are semantically correct: width=640 matches instruction, original_aspect_ratio=0.751563 matches original image (962/1280)
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with width, height, aspect_ratio keys that metric correctly accesses
Edge cases handled: None results, division by zero in aspect ratio, missing files, and exceptions are all handled gracefully
Complete coverage: both requirements (exact width and aspect ratio preservation) are verified
